newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Foshan Lighting approves dividend plan.
newsitem.headline: Foshan Lighting approves dividend plan.

text.p: Shareholders of Foshan Lighting and Electrical Co Ltd have approved the firm's plan to offer a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.477 yuan per share based on 1996 net profits, a company statement said on Tuesday.

The plan was proposed last month by the firm's board of directors and would require final approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, said the statement, published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
An exchange rate for the B share dividend and an ex-dividend date have yet to be fixed, a company official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Foshan posted net profits of 193.11 million yuan in 1996, up 13 percent from 170.24 million yuan in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
